title: Send us an operator's notice about Thursday's service
summary: Metro, Carris, CP, Fertagus, the ferries (TTSL) and the bridges (Lusoponte): when one posts what runs on Thursday 12 November, send the address. Several of their sites cannot be read by our tools.
closes: The operator's own page or official account, and the time you read it.
